model.title: Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation Land Exchange Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Jay Obernolte (R-CA)

summary.text: The bill would authorize an exchange of land between the Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation and the federal government in California, with the tribe trading roughly 1,460 acres of its land for approximately 1,475 acres of National Forest land. As part of the deal, the tribe would agree to help preserve the historical and cultural significance of the Arrowhead landmark site in the San Bernardino Mountains.
